Use official court portals** | • For Canadian cases – visit the *CanLII* website or the specific provincial court’s site.
• For UK cases – use *BAILII* or the *gov.uk* court portal.
• For US cases – check PACER or the state court’s online docket system. | These sites host the full judgments, orders, and docket entries. | | **3.
